summary: Perform functional and non-functional testing of web/mobile applications, analyze requirements, maintain test documentation and triage client/team defects before development.
requirements: 1+ years of web application testing; QA methodologies and processes; HTTP, JSON and REST; API testing with tools such as Postman/Swagger; Chrome DevTools; test documentation and clear bug reports using Jira/Redmine or similar; SQL or NoSQL; cross-browser/device testing; analytical and communication skills. Mobile and AI testing are preferred.
compensation: Numerical salary not disclosed. Benefits include performance reviews, paid vacation/sick leave/public holidays, Apple equipment and learning support.
conditions: The live employer page dates the posting November 13, 2026 and explicitly lists Worldwide. Remote work is an option; company hubs in Kyiv, Warsaw and Berlin are optional alternatives.
